tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground (warm off-white). Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent-deep.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Product cards, inputs, drawers and modals.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Light sand: tonal bands (fabric, gifts, trust line), image grounds, the mega-menu well.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Espresso: the dark moments only (editorial band, footer). Inside it use on-dark, on-dark-muted, line-dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Warm charcoal: primary text, icons, hairline buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, captions, helper text) on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, unselected sizes; 3:1 or better on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Clay (brand): small marks only (logo dot, bag count, selected underline, free-delivery bar, focus-adjacent highlights). Never text, never a large fill. 5% of the screen at most.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Clay-deep: the primary button fill, links and sale prices. White on it passes AA.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: In-stock and confirmed text, always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error text, always with an icon and an instruction.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Admin only: ground of success banners and OK status chips (text success-text, 4.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Admin only: ground of error banners and danger status chips (text danger-text, 4.5:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset (on-dark inside dark sections). 3:1 or better against its surroundings.

tokens.name: scrim-image
tokens.usage: Gradient start for text that sits on photography; keeps type at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind drawers, modals and the search overlay.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Loading skeleton ground, same size as the image it stands in for.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Listing title, editorial line. Fluid: clamp(40px, 5.2cqw, 72px), line-height 1.03.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headings, product title. Fluid: clamp(30px, 3.4cqw, 48px), line-height 1.12.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Drawer titles, tile captions. Fluid: clamp(24px, 2.2cqw, 30px).

styles.name: display-xs
styles.usage: Product names in cards and the bag.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Cut to last, made in Pakistan.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy and form text (16px so phones do not zoom).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Grid gap on phones, chip gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap on desktop, page margin on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row gap between product rows, card text to price.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header to first content, footer columns.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Images, buttons, inputs, tiles: barely softened.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Colour dots, the wishlist heart, the bag count.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The only shadow: under the mega-menu, cart drawer and quick view. Nothing else carries one.

tokens.name: grid-gap-mobile
tokens.usage: Product grid gap under 64rem: tight, so images dominate.

tokens.name: image-ratio
tokens.usage: Every product image, card and gallery: one consistent crop.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Cart drawer and filter drawer width from 40rem.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Scroll reveals, second-image crossfade, page cross-fade.
